title: The steerability of large language models toward data-driven personas
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the ability of Large Language Models to be steered to predict the survey responses (opinions) of individuals based on their religious affiliation as one of several demographic traits. This was compared against a novel data-driven persona approach.
findings: The study found that steering LLMs using their proposed data-driven personas (individual embeddings or cluster embeddings) resulted in significantly higher accuracy in predicting an individual's opinions compared to steering based on single demographic traits, including religious affiliation. The analysis also revealed that the identified opinion clusters were composed of individuals from diverse religious backgrounds, suggesting that grouping by opinion is more nuanced and effective than grouping by religious identity alone.
